title: Core: projectiles leave the hand and converge on the crosshair
player_outcome: Arrows, bullets, magic bolts and thrown weapons come out of the weapon hand, not from the eyes, and still land where the crosshair points.
design: New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Entities/ShotGeometry.cs with HandOffset = (right 0.22, up -0.3, forward 0.45) in the Facing frame; right = Normalize(Cross(Facing, UnitY)).

ShotGeometry.Origin(VoxelWorld w, PlayerEntity p): wanted = Eye + offset; Targeting.CastWhere(w, Eye, wanted - Eye, |wanted - Eye|, solid-cell predicate); on a hit, pull the origin back to 5 cm before the hit (never spawn inside a wall).
ShotGeometry.Direction(PlayerEntity p, Vector3 origin): Normalize(Eye + Aim * AimDistance - origin), falling back to Aim when AimDistance < 1.5 m or the vector degenerates.
ProjectileSystem.Fire: spawn at Origin and apply spread around Direction (replacing p.Eye + dir*0.4 at line 89).
files_add: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Entities/ShotGeometry.cs — hand origin with wall clamp, crosshair convergence
tests: ShotGeometryTests.ArrowsLeaveFromTheHand: wooden_bow plus arrows, ViewDirection +Z, AimDistance 10; the spawned projectile is > 0.3 m from Eye and within 0.1 m of Eye + HandOffset
ShotGeometryTests.ShotsConvergeOnTheCrosshair: the initial velocity direction is within 1° of Normalize(Eye + Aim*10 - origin)
ShotGeometryTests.NeverSpawnsInsideAWall: a stone column at the right shoulder keeps the origin cell non-solid
ArsenalTests (boomerang, bombs, minions) stay green; combat.cmds 'assert projectiles.count >= 1' still passes (release stays instant)
verification: Manual: shoot at a small target 20 m away in third person; arrows hit the crosshair
risks: Very close aim points give steep convergence angles; the 1.5 m fallback avoids arrows flying sideways.
Minion or bobber spawns also go through Spawn; only Fire changes, so fishing and minions are unaffected.
